summary: Feature request to add JWT-based authorization support for cluster-to-cluster replication. Currently replication relies on mTLS for transport security but lacks JWT-based authorization capabilities, which are already available for client-to-server communication.
userImpact: Multi-cluster Temporal deployments cannot enforce JWT-based authorization on replication traffic, limiting fine-grained access control between clusters.
proposedFix: Add configuration options to attach JWT tokens to outbound replication connections, with per-remote-cluster token configuration and wildcard matching support similar to existing TLS configuration.
keyQuote: Cluster-to-cluster replication currently relies on mTLS for securing the connection but has no support for JWT-based authorization.
